snippet.title: MICRO BATTLES - iOS Android [Donut Games]
snippet.description:
Micro Battles is an 8-bit inspired HEAD-TO-HEAD battle game, focusing on the fun simplicity and quirkiness of classic video game systems.

Free for iOS - http://bit.ly/1wm2esb
Free for Android - http://bit.ly/1sKShUs

Donut Games website:
http://www.donutgames.com

Credit goes to Goto80 for the chiptune audiorosputnick used in this video.

http://freemusicarchive.org/music/Goto80/
